blocks.title: Agile methodology
blocks.text: Agile methodology software banane ka lachakdar (flexible) aur dhalne wala tareeqa hai. Waterfall model ke ulat, jo qadmon ki sakht tarteeb par chalta hai, Agile software ke chhote, kaam karte hisse jaldi deta aur project ke aage barhne ke saath tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalta hai, chhote chakkaron (iterations ya sprints) mein kaam kar ke aur jaldi raaye le kar (Fig. 1.3).

items: Continuous integration: code ki tabdeeliyan baqaidagi se markazi repository mein milana ta ke masail jaldi pakre aur theek kiye ja sakein.
Test-driven development: code likhne se pehle tests likhna ta ke software tawaqqo ke mutabiq kaam kare.
Pair programming: do developers ek workstation par, ek code likhta aur doosra foran (real time) jaanchta hai.

blocks.alt: AGILE lafz ke gird rangeen teer-numa hisson ka chakkar. Neeche baen se surkh teer, 1 Requirements, andar aata hai; phir chakkar 2 Design, 3 Development, 4 Testing, 5 Deployment aur 6 Review se guzarta hai, aur neeche daen se hara teer bahar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.3: Agile Methodology (kitab ki Figure 1.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Requirements (1) se kaam shuru hota hai aur phir Design, Development, Testing, Deployment aur Review (2 se 6) ka chhota chakkar (iteration ya sprint) chalta hai. Review ke baad agla chakkar phir isi tarah chalta hai, is liye software chhote chhote hisson mein jaldi milta hai aur har chakkar ke baad raaye (feedback) li ja sakti hai. Waterfall ki seedhi lakeer ke muqable mein yahan gol chakkar hai.

blocks.caption: Agile: fawaid aur hudood
rows: Zyada lachak: development shuru hone ke baad bhi requirements badal sakti hain
Barhane ke masail: kai teams wale bare projects mein ehtiyat se ham-aahangi chahiye
Customer ki behtar tasalli: baar baar kaam karte releases se customer taraqqi dekhta aur raaye deta hai
Stakeholders ki shirkat: tamam stakeholders ki fa'al shirkat chahiye
Kam pehle se andaza: waqt aur aakhri daira (scope) ka andaza mushkil

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa model chhote chakkaron ya sprints mein kaam karta hai (MCQ 4)? Agile mein continuous integration samjhaiye aur is ki ahmiyat bataiye (short question 3).
blocks.explanation: Agile methodology, option (b). Continuous integration mein har developer code ki chhoti tabdeeliyan din mein kai baar mushtarka repository mein milata hai, aur har milap par khudkar builds aur tests chalte hain; takrao aur bugs chhote hone par hi pakre jate hain, to team ke paas hamesha kaam karta, test shuda code hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ek saada mobile app project chala rahe hain. Agile kaise istemal karenge (long question 2)?
blocks.explanation: Features ko tarjeeh (priority) wali list (backlog) mein rakhein; ek do hafte ke chhote sprints banayein, har ek mein chand features bana aur test karein; code musalsal milayein aur test karein; har sprint ke aakhir mein client ko kaam karti app dikha kar raaye lein aur dobara mansooba banayein; app tayyar hone tak dohrayein, phir release kar ke behtar karte rahein.

items: Agile: lachakdar, dhalne wala; chhote iterations ya sprints mein chhote kaam karte hisse aur jaldi raaye (Fig. 1.3).
Tareeqe: continuous integration, test-driven development, pair programming. Fawaid: lachak, customer ki tasalli; hudood: barhana, stakeholders ki shirkat, kam andaza.
